---
name: IDPM task
description: Track a task with effort estimates and actuals
---

Do all work for this task in a branch called issue-XX

## Work and completion criteria

Describe the task and how to verify it is complete. Link related issues and requirements.

## Effort tracking

- Estimated time to complete (minutes, hours, or both; include units): Not yet recorded
- Estimator: Not yet recorded
- Actual time to complete (minutes, hours, or both; coding + non-coding): Not yet recorded
- Coding effort (minutes, hours, or both; include units): Not yet recorded
- Non-coding effort (minutes, hours, or both; include units): Not yet recorded
- AI-assisted coding breakdown (include units; included in coding effort, not additional): prompt engineering, generation/post-processing, verification/debugging, integration/refactoring — Not yet recorded
- AI-assisted non-coding work (included in non-coding effort): Not yet recorded

After creating the issue, replace `XX` with its actual issue number. People may report time in minutes, hours, or both (for example, `10 minutes` or `1 hour 15 minutes`). Add the estimate's basis as a comment. E57B requires the project's numeric fields in hours: divide minutes by 60 when entering them (10 minutes = approximately 0.167 hours). The final E57B report uses minutes. Update actuals as work progresses; do not invent values or count the AI breakdown twice.
